links.comparator_used: Discordant (false-positive) AI flag disclosed without explanatory note (AI Flagged scenario)
links.outcome: Patient anxiety, trust, second-opinion intent and legal action intent after disclosure of a discordant AI result
links.effect: Anxiety 25.3% with explanation (OR = 0.26 vs flag without explanation). Versus Radiologist Only, AI Flagged + Explanation showed a modest anxiety increase (p = 0.04) and no significant trust reduction (p = 0.42).
links.tradeoff: Anxiety remained modestly higher than in the Radiologist Only scenario (p = 0.04) even with the explanation.
links.quote: Adding explanatory context significantly mitigated these effects (e.g., anxiety: 25.3%; OR = 0.26).

links.comparator_used: Radiologist Only report with no AI result disclosed
links.outcome: Trust in radiologist, anxiety, second-opinion intent and legal action intent when a discordant AI result is disclosed
links.effect: Trust 73.0 vs 90.1 (p < 0.001); anxiety 58.0% vs 16.0% (OR = 15.4); second-opinion intent 50.0% vs 8.7% (OR = 10.2); legal action consideration 60.7% vs 38.7% (OR = 2.49). AI approval stayed above 85% in all groups.
links.tradeoff: Disclosing a discordant AI flag lowered trust and increased anxiety, follow-up seeking and litigation intent.
links.quote: Disclosure of a discordant AI result significantly reduced trust in the radiologist (73.0 vs 90.1; p < 0.001), and increased anxiety (58.0% vs 16.0%; OR = 15.4), second-opinion intent (50.0% vs 8.7%; OR = 10.2), and legal action consideration (60.7% vs 38.7%; OR = 2.49).

design_hint: AI disclosure and contextual explanatory notes in radiology reports
